original: toyaughe maraṇaṃ bhavaty aniyataṃ naikāntato vidyate
analyzed: toya oghe maraṇam bhavati aniyatam na ekāntataḥ vidyate

original: kleśaughe tu nṛṇām adāntamaraṇaṃ niḥsaṃśayaṃ vidyate |
analyzed: kleśa oghe tu nṛṇām adānta maraṇam niḥsaṃśayam vidyate

original: toyaughe patitasya cetasi bhaved duḥkhapravṛttir na vā
analyzed: toya oghe patitasya cetasi bhavet duḥkha pravṛttiḥ na vā

original: kleśaughe patitasya duḥkham atulaṃ kāyasya cittasya ca || 27.1.4
analyzed: kleśa oghe patitasya duḥkham atulam kāyasya cittasya ca

original: vegodbhrāntajalā nadī jalanidhiṃ kiṃcit kadācin nayet
analyzed: vega udbhrānta jalā nadī jalanidhim kiṃcid kadācid nayet

original: saṃsārārṇavam arṇavād api paraṃ tṛṣṇānadī karṣati |
analyzed: saṃsāra arṇavam arṇavāt api param tṛṣṇā nadī karṣati

original: paryāptiṃ samupaiti parvatanadī meghāgame cāmbubhir
analyzed: paryāptim samupaiti parvata nadī meghāgame ca ambubhiḥ

original: vistīrṇair api tṛptim eti viṣayair na tv eva tṛṣṇānadī || 27.1.5
analyzed: vistīrṇaiḥ api tṛptim eti viṣayaiḥ na tu eva tṛṣṇā nadī

original: yasmin na janma na jarā na rujo na mṛtyuḥ
analyzed: yasmin na janma na jarā na rujaḥ na mṛtyuḥ

original: śleṣo 'priyair na ca na ca priyaviprayogaḥ |
analyzed: śleṣo priyaiḥ na ca na ca priya viprayogaḥ

original: nāprāptir asti viṣayasya ca kāṅkṣitasya
analyzed: na aprāptiḥ asti viṣayasya ca kāṅkṣitasya

original: tan me sukhaṃ matam ato 'nyad avaimi duḥkham || 27.1.7
analyzed: tat me sukham matam atas avaimi duḥkham

original: gatvāpi pāram udadher bahusaṃśayasya
analyzed: gatvā api pāram udadheḥ bahu saṃśayasya

original: syāt śvāpadāgninṛpacauragataṃ hi duḥkham |
analyzed: syāt śvāpada agni nṛpa caura gatam hi duḥkham

original: saṃsārasāgarajalasya tu pāram etya
analyzed: saṃsāra sāgara jalasya tu pāram etya

original: duḥkhaṃ susūkṣmam api nāsti parā ca śāntiḥ || 27.1.8
analyzed: duḥkham su sūkṣmam api nā asti parā ca śāntiḥ

original: yathā vaidyas samyak prakṛtim avagamyāturagatāṃ
analyzed: yathā vaidyaḥ samyak prakṛtim avagamya ātura gatām

original: kṣayārthaṃ vyādhīnāṃ kathayati hitān auṣadhavidhīn |
analyzed: kṣaya artham vyādhīnām kathayati hitān auṣadha vidhīn

original: vicitrān sattvānāṃ prakṛtim avagamyāśayagatāṃ
analyzed: vicitrān sattvānām prakṛtim avagamya āśaya gatām

original: tathā buddho dharmaṃ sadṛśam avadad bheṣajam iveti || 27.1.13
analyzed: tathā buddhaḥ dharmam sadṛśam avadat bheṣajam iva iti

original: §1 evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavāñ chrāvastyāṃ viharati jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme | tatra bhagavān bhikṣūn āmantrayate sma |
analyzed: evam mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān śrāvastyām viharati jetavane nāthapiṇḍadasya ārāme tatra bhagavān bhikṣūn āmantrayate sma

original: §2 tadyathā bhikṣavaḥ kṣāranadyāḥ kukūlakūlāyāḥ kaṇṭakopāstaraṇāyā andhāyās tamaso 'ndhakāratamisrāyā mahājanakāyo 'nusrota uhyate |
analyzed: tat yathā bhikṣavaḥ kṣāra nadyāḥ kukūla kūlāyāḥ kaṇṭaka upāstaraṇāyāḥ andhāyāḥ tamasaḥ ndhakāra tamisrāyāḥ mahā jana kāyaḥ nusrotaḥ uhyate

original: §3 tatra syād ekaḥ sattvo 'bālajātīyo 'mūḍhajātīyaḥ saprajñājātīyaḥ sukhakāmo duḥkhapratikūlo jīvitukāmo na martukāmo maraṇapratikūlaḥ | tasyaivaṃ syāt | kiṃ punar aham anayā kṣāranadyā kukūlakūlayā kaṇḍakopāstaraṇāyā andhayā tamasā andhakāratamisrāyā anusrota uhye | yan nv ahaṃ hastābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ pratisroto vyāyaccheya |
analyzed: tatra syāt ekaḥ sattvaḥ bāla jātīyaḥ mūḍha jātīyaḥ saprajñā jātīyaḥ sukha kāmaḥ duḥkha pratikūlaḥ jīvitu kāmaḥ na martu kāmaḥ maraṇa pratikūlaḥ tasya evam syāt kim punar aham anayā kṣāranadyā kukūla kūlayā kaṇḍaka upāstaraṇāyāḥ andhayā tamasā andhakāra tamisrāyāḥ anusrotaḥ uhye yat nu aham hastābhyām pādābhyām pratisrotas vyāyaccheya

original: sa idaṃ pratisaṃkhyāya bhūyasyā mātrayā hastābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ pratisroto vyāyacchate |
analyzed: saḥ idam pratisaṃkhyāya bhūyasyā mātrayā hastābhyām pādābhyām pratisrotas vyāyacchate

original: §4 sa tatra paśyed ālokam | tasyaivaṃ syāt | mahāndhatāyaṃ viśeṣo 'dhigato yaduta ālokaḥ | yan nv ahaṃ bhūyasyā mātrayā hastābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ pratisroto vyāyaccheya | sa idaṃ pratisaṃkhyāya bhūyasyā mātrayā hastābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ pratisroto vyāyacchate |
analyzed: sa tatra paśyet ālokam tasya evam syāt mahā andhatā ayam viśeṣaḥ dhigataḥ yat uta ālokaḥ yat nu aham bhūyasyā mātrayā hastābhyām pādābhyām pratisrotas vyāyaccheya saḥ idam pratisaṃkhyāya bhūyasyā mātrayā hastābhyām pādābhyām pratisrotas vyāyacchate

original: §5 sa tatra paśyet samaṃ pṛthivīpradeśam | sa tatra pratiṣṭhet | sa tatra pratiṣṭhāya caturdiśaṃ vyavalokayet | sa tatra paśyen mahāśailaṃ parvatam akhaṇḍam acchidram asuṣiraṃ saṃvṛttam ekaghanam | sa tam abhirohet |
analyzed: sa tatra paśyet samam pṛthivī pradeśam sa tatra pratiṣṭhet sa tatra pratiṣṭhāya caturdiśam vyavalokayet sa tatra paśyet mahā śailam parvatam akhaṇḍam acchidram a suṣiram saṃvṛttam eka ghanam sa tam abhirohet

original: §6 sa tatra paśyed aṣṭāṅgopetaṃ pānīyaṃ śītalaṃ ca svādu ca laghu ca mṛdu ca svacchaṃ ca niḥpūtigandhikaṃ pibataś ca kaṇṭhaṃ na kṣiṇoti pītaṃ ca kukṣiṃ na vyābādhate | sa tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca vigatajvaro vigataparidāhas tam eva mahāśailaṃ parvatam abhirohet |
analyzed: sa tatra paśyet aṣṭāṅga upetam pānīyam śītalam ca svādu ca laghu ca mṛdu ca svaccham ca niḥpūtigandhikam pibataḥ ca kaṇṭham na kṣiṇoti pītam ca kukṣim na vyābādhate sa tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca vigata jvaraḥ vigata paridāhaḥ tam eva mahā śailam parvatam abhirohet

original: §7 sa tatra paśyet sapta puṣpajātāni tadyathā utpalaṃ padmaṃ kumudaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ saugandhikaṃ mṛdugandhikam atimuktam eva saptamam | sa tāny eva sapta puṣpajātāny upajighraṃs tam eva mahāśailaṃ parvatam abhirohet |
analyzed: sa tatra paśyet sapta puṣpa jātāni tat yathā utpalam padmam kumudam puṇḍarīkam saugandhikam mṛdugandhikam atimuktam eva saptamam sa tāni eva sapta puṣpa jātāni upajighran tam eva mahā śailam parvatam abhirohet

original: §8 sa tatra paśyec catuṣkaḍevaraṃ sopānam | sa tad abhirohet | sa tatra paśyet pañcasthūṇaṃ vimānam | sa tatra praviśet | sa tatra paśyet paryaṅkaṃ paṭṭikopetaṃ goṇikāstṛtaṃ tūlikāstṛtaṃ bṛhatikāstṛtaṃ citrikāstṛtaṃ paṭalikāstṛtaṃ kācalindaprāvārapratyāstaraṇaṃ sottarocchadapaṭam ubhayatopahitalohitopadhānaṃ nānāpuṣpāvakīrṇaṃ ramaṇīyam |
analyzed: sa tatra paśyet catuṣka ḍevaram sopānam sa tat abhirohet sa tatra paśyet pañca sthūṇam vimānam sa tatra praviśet sa tatra paśyet paryaṅkam paṭṭikā upetam goṇikā āstṛtam tūlikā āstṛtam bṛhatikā āstṛtam citrikā āstṛtam paṭalikā āstṛtam kāca linda prāvāra pratyāstaraṇam sa uttarocchada paṭam ubhayatas upahita lohita upadhānam nānā puṣpa avakīrṇam ramaṇīyam

original: sa tatrābhiniṣīded vābhinipadyeta vā | tasya tatrābhiniṣaṇṇasya vābhinipannasya vā caturdiśaṃ śītalā vāyavo vāyeyuḥ |
analyzed: sa tatra abhiniṣīdet vā abhinipadyeta vā tasya tatra abhiniṣaṇṇasya vā abhinipannasya vā caturdiśam śītalāḥ vāyavaḥ vāyeyuḥ

original: §9 sa tatra śabdam udīrayet | ghoṣam anuśrāvayet | anenāryā anena bhadramukhā asyāḥ kṣāranadyāḥ kukūlakūlāyāḥ kaṇṭakopāstaraṇāyās tamaso 'ndhakāratamisrāyāḥ pratisroto niḥsaraṇam | apare evam āhuḥ | katamena āryāḥ katamena bhadramukhā asyāḥ kṣāranadyāḥ kukūlakūlayāḥ kaṇṭakopāstaraṇāyā andhāyās tamaso 'ndhakāratamisrāyāḥ pratisroto niḥśaraṇam |
analyzed: sa tatra śabdam udīrayet ghoṣam anuśrāvayet anena āryāḥ anena bhadra mukhāḥ asyāḥ kṣāranadyāḥ kukūla kūlāyāḥ kaṇṭaka upāstaraṇāyāḥ tamasaḥ ndhakāra tamisrāyāḥ pratisrotas niḥsaraṇam apare evam āhuḥ katamena āryāḥ katamena bhadra mukhāḥ asyāḥ kṣāranadyāḥ kukūla kūlayāḥ kaṇṭaka upāstaraṇāyāḥ andhāyāḥ tamasaḥ ndhakāra tamisrāyāḥ pratisrotas niḥśaraṇam

original: anye evam āhuḥ | eṣo 'pi mārṣā na jānāty eṣo 'pi na paśyaty eṣo 'py anayā kṣāranadyā kukūlakūlayā kaṇṭakopāstaraṇayā andhayā tamasā andhakāratamisrāyā 'nusrota uhyate |
analyzed: anye evam āhuḥ eṣaḥ u pi mārṣāḥ na jānāti eṣaḥ u pi na paśyati eṣaḥ u pi anayā kṣāranadyā kukūla kūlayā kaṇṭaka upāstaraṇayā andhayā tamasā andhakāra tamisrāyāḥ nusrotaḥ uhyate

original: §10 iti hi bhikṣava upameyaṃ kṛtā yāvad evārthasya vijñaptaye | ayaṃ ca punar atrārtho draṣṭavyaḥ | kṣāra iti bhikṣavas trayāṇāṃ pāpakānām akuśalānāṃ vitarkāṇāṃ etad adhivacanam | tadyathā kāmavitarkasya vyāpādavitarkasya vihiṃsāvitarkasya | nadīti bhikṣavas tisṛṇāṃ tṛṣṇānām etad adhivacanam | tadyathā kāmatṛṣṇāyā rūpatṛṣṇāyā ārūpyatṛṣṇāyāḥ |
analyzed: iti hi bhikṣavaḥ upameyam kṛtā yāvat eva arthasya vijñaptaye ayam ca punar atra arthaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ kṣāraḥ iti bhikṣavaḥ trayāṇām pāpakānām akuśalānām vitarkāṇām etat adhivacanam tat yathā kāma vitarkasya vyāpāda vitarkasya vihiṃsā vitarkasya nadī iti bhikṣavaḥ tisṛṇām tṛṣṇānām etat adhivacanam tat yathā kāma tṛṣṇāyāḥ rūpa tṛṣṇāyāḥ ārūpya tṛṣṇāyāḥ

original: kukūlakūleti ṣaṇṇām adhyātmikānām āyatanānām etad adhivacanam | andhakāratamisrety avidyāndhakārasyaitad adhivacanam | mahājanakāya iti bālapṛthagjanānām etad adhivacanam |
analyzed: kukūla kūlā iti ṣaṇṇām adhyātmikānām āyatanānām etat adhivacanam andhakāra tamisrā iti avidyā andhakārasya etat adhivacanam mahā jana kāyaḥ iti bāla pṛthagjanānām etat adhivacanam

original: §11 ekaḥ sattvo 'bālajātīyo 'mūḍhajātīyaḥ saprajñajātīya iti bodhisattvasyaitad adhivacanam | srota iti saṃsārasrotasa etad adhivacanam | hastābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ pratisroto vyāyaccheyeti vīryārambhasyaitad adhivacanam |
analyzed: ekaḥ sattvaḥ bāla jātīyaḥ mūḍha jātīyaḥ saprajña jātīyaḥ iti bodhisattvasya etat adhivacanam srotaḥ iti saṃsāra srotasaḥ etat adhivacanam hastābhyām pādābhyām pratisrotas vyāyaccheya iti vīrya ārambhasya etat adhivacanam

original: §12 āloka iti dharmanidhyānakṣānter etad adhivacanam |
analyzed: ālokaḥ iti dharma nidhyāna kṣānteḥ etat adhivacanam

original: §13 samaḥ pṛthivīpradeśa iti śīlānām etad adhivacanam | caturdiśaṃ vyavalokanam iti caturṇām āryasatyānām etad adhivacanam | mahāśailaḥ parvata iti samyagdṛṣṭer adhivacanam |
analyzed: samaḥ pṛthivī pradeśaḥ iti śīlānām etat adhivacanam caturdiśam vyavalokanam iti caturṇām ārya satyānām etat adhivacanam mahā śailaḥ parvataḥ iti samyak dṛṣṭeḥ adhivacanam

original: §14 aṣṭāṅgopetaṃ pānīyam ity āryāṣṭāṅgasya mārgasyaitad adhivacanam | sapta puṣpajātānīti saptānāṃ bodhyaṅgānām etad adhivacanam | catuḥkaḍevaraṃ sopānam iti caturṇām ṛddhipādānām etad adhivacanam | pañcasthūṇaṃ vimānam iti pañcānām indriyāṇām etad adhivacanam |
analyzed: aṣṭāṅga upetam pānīyam iti ārya aṣṭāṅgasya mārgasya etat adhivacanam sapta puṣpajātāni iti saptānām bodhyaṅgānām etat adhivacanam catur kaḍevaram sopānam iti caturṇām ṛddhipādānām etat adhivacanam pañca sthūṇam vimānam iti pañcānām indriyāṇām etat adhivacanam

original: §15 paryaṅkam iti sopadhiśeṣanirvāṇadhātor etad adhivacanam | puṣpāvakīrṇaṃ ramaṇīyam iti dhyānavimokṣasamādhisamāpattīnām etad adhivacanam | sa tatrābhiniṣaṇṇo vābhinipaṇṇo veti tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasyaitad adhivacanam | caturdiśaṃ śītalā vāyavo vāntīti caturṇām ādhicaitasikānāṃ dṛṣṭadharmasukhavihārāṇām etad adhivacanam |
analyzed: paryaṅkam iti sa upadhi śeṣa nirvāṇa dhātoḥ etat adhivacanam puṣpa avakīrṇam ramaṇīyam iti dhyāna vimokṣa samādhi samāpattīnām etat adhivacanam sa tatra abhiniṣaṇṇaḥ vā abhinipaṇṇaḥ vā iti tathāgatasya arhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya etat adhivacanam caturdiśam śītalāḥ vāyavaḥ vānti iti caturṇām ādhicaitasikānām dṛṣṭadharma sukha vihārāṇām etat adhivacanam

original: §16 śabdam udīrayati ghoṣam anuśrāvayatīti dharmadeśanāyā etad adhivacanam |
analyzed: śabdam udīrayati ghoṣam anuśrāvayati iti dharma deśanāyāḥ etat adhivacanam

original: §17 tatra ye te evam āhuḥ | katamenāryāḥ katamena bhadramukhā asyāḥ kṣāranadyāḥ kukūlakūlāyāḥ kaṇṭakopāstaraṇāyā andhāyās tamaso 'ndhakāratamisrāyāḥ pratisroto niḥsaraṇam iti śāriputramaudgalyāyanayor bhikṣvor etad adhivacanam | pañcakānām upapañcakānāṃ ṣaṣṭer bhadravargīyāṇāṃ pūgānām etad adhivacanam iti |
analyzed: tatra ye te evam āhuḥ katamena āryāḥ katamena bhadra mukhāḥ asyāḥ kṣāra nadyāḥ kukūla kūlāyāḥ kaṇṭaka upāstaraṇāyāḥ andhāyāḥ tamasaḥ ndhakāra tamisrāyāḥ pratisrotas niḥsaraṇam iti śāriputra maudgalyāyanayoḥ bhikṣvoḥ etat adhivacanam pañcakānām upapañcakānām ṣaṣṭeḥ bhadravargīyāṇām pūgānām etat adhivacanam iti

original: ye vā punar anye 'pi samyagdṛṣṭayaḥ samyakpratipannāḥ |
analyzed: ye vā punar anye samyak dṛṣṭayaḥ samyak pratipannāḥ

original: §18 tatra ye te evam āhuḥ | eṣo 'pi mārṣā na jānāty eṣo 'pi na paśyaty eṣo 'py anayā kṣāranadyā kukūlakūlayā kaṇṭakopāstaraṇayā andhayā tamasā andhakāratamisrayānusroto uhyata iti ṣaṇṇāṃ śāstṝṇām etad adhivacanam |
analyzed: tatra ye te evam āhuḥ eṣaḥ u pi mārṣāḥ na jānāti eṣaḥ u pi na paśyati eṣaḥ u pi anayā kṣāranadyā kukūla kūlayā kaṇṭaka upāstaraṇayā andhayā tamasā andhakāra tamisrayā anusrotaḥ uhyate iti ṣaṇṇām śāstṝṇām etat adhivacanam

original: tadyathā pūraṇasya kāśyapasya maskariṇo gośālīputrasya saṃjayino vairaṭṭīputrasya ajitasya keśakambalasya kakudasya kātyāyanīputrasya nirgranthasya jātiputrasyeti | ye vā punar anye ʼpi mithyādṛṣṭayo mithyāpratipannāḥ |
analyzed: tat yathā pūraṇasya kāśyapasya maskariṇaḥ gośālīputrasya saṃjayinaḥ vairaṭṭīputrasya ajitasya keśakambalasya kakudasya kātyāyanīputrasya nirgranthasya jātiputrasya iti ye vā punar anye mithyādṛṣṭayaḥ mithyā pratipannāḥ

original: §19 iti hi bhikṣavo yat tac chāstā śrāvakāṇāṃ karaṇīyam anukampakena kāruṇikenārthakāmena hitaiṣiṇā karuṇāyamānena kṛtaṃ vas tan mayā | yuṣmābhir idānīṃ karaṇīyam |
analyzed: iti hi bhikṣavaḥ yat tat śāstā śrāvakāṇām karaṇīyam anukampakena kāruṇikena artha kāmena hita eṣiṇā karuṇāyamānena kṛtam vaḥ tat mayā yuṣmābhiḥ idānīm karaṇīyam

original: etāni bhikṣavo 'raṇyāni vṛkṣamūlāni śūnyāgārāṇi parvatakandarāṇi giriguhāpalālapuñjābhyavakāśaśmaśānavanaprasthāni prāntāni śayanāsanāni dhyāyata bhikṣavo mā pramādyata mā paścād vipratisāriṇo bhūta | idam asmākam anuśāsanam || idam avocat ||
analyzed: etāni bhikṣavaḥ raṇyāni vṛkṣa mūlāni śūnya āgārāṇi parvata kandarāṇi giri guhā palāla puñja abhyavakāśa śmaśāna vana prasthāni prāntāni śayana āsanāni dhyāyata bhikṣavaḥ mā pramādyata mā paścāt vipratisāriṇaḥ bhūtaḥ idam asmākam anuśāsanam idam avocat
